description:
ABOUT BRACKET BOT

Robots today are where computers were when they filled a room: expensive, hard to use, and run by specialists.

 

We’re making the one anyone can afford. That means designing all of it ourselves: the parts, the boards, the connectors, the software and the ML.

 

Then we put our robots to work in the real world to learn what they need next.

 

We’re backed by Fifty Years (Scott Phoenix), BoxGroup, SV Angel, Betaworks, Pace Capital, and angels including Nat Friedman, Logan Kilpatrick (Google AI), Guillermo Rauch (Vercel) and others from Tesla AI, Physical Intelligence, and Markforged.

 
 


ABOUT THE ROLE

A robot needs to work where it is deployed, across unfamiliar environments and the practical constraints that appear outside the lab.

 

We’re hiring a Robotics Software Engineer - International Deployments to bring our robots into real-world use and turn field experience into better software. You’ll work across integration, navigation, perception, debugging, and deployment tooling.

 

The role is based onsite in San Francisco and includes international deployment work. You’ll work with the engineering team and the people using our robots to diagnose problems, ship fixes, and make each deployment more repeatable.

 
 


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Prepare, configure, test, and deploy robot software for real-world environments.

 - Debug navigation, perception, sensor integration, and system behavior on physical robots.

 - Work directly with users and deployment partners to understand problems and reproduce failures.

 - Turn field findings into software fixes, tests, documentation, and improved deployment tools.

 - Collaborate with mechanical, electrical, and machine learning engineers on issues that cross system boundaries.

 - Help make setup, diagnostics, and support more reliable across international deployments.

 


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong robotics software engineering fundamentals.

 - Experience integrating and debugging software on physical robots.

 - Ability to investigate unfamiliar systems, identify root causes, and deliver practical fixes.

 - Clear communication with engineers and the people operating the robot.

 - Comfort with hands-on field work, changing conditions, and international deployment work.

 


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with SLAM, localization, navigation, perception, or sensor fusion.

 - Experience with ROS or custom robotics stacks.

 - Experience deploying or supporting robotics systems outside a lab.

 - Experience building diagnostics, logging, remote support, or deployment tools.

 


IMPORTANT NOTES

 - This role combines software engineering with hands-on deployment work.

 - San Francisco is the home base; international deployments are part of the role.

 - We value sound judgment, reliable systems, and follow-through when problems reach the field.

 


HOW TO APPLY

Apply at bracketbot.com/apply https://bracketbot.com/apply. It takes a name or a link and about ten seconds: no resume, no form. One application covers every role, and we match you to one during interviews. The Apply button on this page works too.

 

The process is a 15-minute call, a review of your past work, then a work trial of two to five days with us in San Francisco. The job is onsite here, but you don’t need to live here yet.

 

Bracket Bot is an equal opportunity employer. We’re building a diverse team and welcome applicants from all backgrounds.
